settings.prompt_prefix:
Answer this question about the local repository. Cite source paths and line numbers, and state any uncertainty. You may use the available repository tools. Do not edit files, use the web, inspect other repositories, or delegate to other agents.

Choose tools by capability, including native search when it directly exposes the needed fact. Use semantic search for unknown implementation locations. find_symbols supports functions, methods and classes, not assignments or attributes; use list_symbols for a compact outline including assignments, or targeted text search. Use resolve_definition for a name at a source position and find_references for broader uses than calls. Treat remembered names as hypotheses. After one empty exact-name lookup, switch to behavior or text search instead of trying guessed name variants. Prefer relevant methods over large class excerpts, whose first lines may be mostly documentation. Start with 3..5 results and narrow by path when possible. Query graph relationships only when they answer an unresolved part of the question. For implementation lookup, request include_code=true initially; the parameter is not include_source. Codeaware returns indexed source with freshness checks: reuse it and cite returned paths and line ranges directly. Do not reread source merely to verify returned code. Truncation alone does not require another read. Make another call only to resolve a specific essential missing fact or unavailable tool capability. Stop when the question and citations are supported; continue when essential evidence is missing. Missing static edges are incomplete evidence, not proof that a runtime relationship is absent.

comparison_limit: One observation per condition/question. Prompt v5 and three new Jedi tools combined. New tools verified in preflight/tests, but not exercised by agent when counts are zero; no isolated effect estimate.
